rows.text: La la la la la~ huh? You're back! It's natural for the conductor to feel relieved when their passengers return safely!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: You finally got some leisure time. Don't forget to grab some sleep when you're done wandering about, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Sounds nice. If only Pom-Pom could go out on expeditions with you...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Quit being a nuisance! Pom-Pom is working!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Another peaceful day... La la la la la⁓
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
